names.ja: ドラセナ・フラグランス

light.best.quote: Keep it in bright to moderate, filtered light.

light.min.quote: if light levels are too low, the leaves will narrow

light.directSun.quote: Direct sun can burn the foliage

temperature.minC.quote: Keep the temperature above 50 degrees F if possible.

temperature.idealC.quote: Corn plants thrive in temperatures of 70 to 80 degrees F.

humidity.quote: Leaves can turn brown at the tips if indoor humidity is too low.

watering.growing.quote: Keep the soil moist during the growing season

watering.winter.quote: cut back on the water in the winter

tips.ja: フッ素や塩類の蓄積に弱い。葉先が茶色くなったら月に一度、鉢土を水で洗い流す。
tips.quote: It is sensitive to fluorides and built-up salts, so if leaves turn brown, try watering with non-fluoridated water and flush salts monthly.

tips.ja: 暖房で乾燥する冬は、加湿器で葉先の枯れを防げる。
tips.quote: A humidifier may help to prevent leaf tip browning, especially in the winter when the house is heated.

tips.ja: 葉先やふちが乾いて枯れるのは、たいてい湿度不足。
tips.quote: Dry tips and edges are usually caused by too little humidity.

tips.ja: 急に葉がたくさん落ちるのは、温度の変化・すきま風・水のやりすぎ・水はけの悪さ・害虫。
tips.quote: A sudden loss of many leaves can be caused by changes in temperature, drafts, too much water, poor drainage or heavy insect infestations.
